description: Presidential Secretariat - Approval of Retirement of General Ratnayake Mudiyanselage Dayaratna Ratnayake from the Position of the Head of Sri Lanka Army and Promotion and Appointment of Major General A. W. J. C. de Silva to the Rank of Lieutenant General and as the Head of the Sri Lanka Army -The Correction Notice of the Appointment Date of Lieutenant Genaral R. M. Dayaratna Ratnayake is Published in Gazette Ex.ord. No. 1903/60 of 27.02.2015
reasoning: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (promotions and appointments of named military officers - Major General A.W.J.C. de Silva and Lieutenant General Ratnayake Mudiyanselage Dayaratna Ratnayake) with basic titles only (Head of Sri Lanka Army, General of Sri Lanka Army). It does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities or descriptions of what these positions are responsible for in terms of subject areas. The content focuses exclusively on personnel actions without structural/administrative changes.
